# Drive Music

> A personal music player for the audio files in your own Google Drive. It streams and caches tracks straight from Drive, mixes them like a DJ, and syncs what is playing across your devices. No server-side database, no ads, no tracking.

Drive Music signs in with Google and asks only for read-only Drive access. Audio, playlists and the listening model stay on the device, in IndexedDB.

## Features

- Plays audio from your Google Drive, with offline downloads per track or in bulk
- DJ-style auto mix: track analysis (BPM, key), beatmatching, crossfades and a per-transition editor
- Gapless playback, volume normalization, a 3-band equalizer and spatial audio
- Playlists, favorites, a Drive folder browser and an offline library with search
- An on-device recommendation model that weights shuffle by what you actually listen to
- Cross-device "now playing" sync and "Play here"
- Eight themes, installable as an app (PWA)
